description: The Assembly '93 Invitation Intro by Future Crew, their invitation to Assembly '93 in Kerava, Finland, running from its original files in your browser.
about: The Assembly '93 Invitation Intro is Future Crew's invitation to Assembly '93, held from 30 July to 1 August 1993 at the Nikkarin yläaste school in Kerava, Finland. It was released on 15 June 1993.

Its readme says it was made “to tell you about Assembly'93 in a more peaceful and designed way”, not to show effects: pages of text over one background, in 640x480 with 16 colors, to an eight-channel Scream Tracker 3 module by Purple Motion. The background reads “ASSEMBY '93”, misspelled in the original.
It runs for about ten minutes. Its last page asks for Escape, which shows Future Crew's contact screen and returns to DOS; until then it waits.
The archive is Future Crew's package as released: with the intro come the party's information files and three scanned maps of the way to the party place.
released: Released on 15 June 1993, as the invitation to Assembly '93 (30 July to 1 August 1993, Kerava, Finland).
credits: Code by Trug, with the music player by Psi. Music by Purple Motion (“World of plastic”, as Demozoo names it), graphics by Marvel, texts and maps by Gore and Jake.
terms: Its own files state none. Future Crew's information files, which list it among their releases, make all their demos freeware: “you can copy and distribute them freely as long as you make no modifications to them.”
accuracy: DosKit gives it a Gravis UltraSound, which it finds by itself; without one it would ask for a mixing rate.
Its pages keep pace with a capture published by AssemblyTV to within 5 seconds.
Mono: js-dos mixes the two channels into one.
imageAlt: The Assembly '93 Invitation Intro's car over the Future Crew logo, running in DosKit
